text: 11.3 1 I'd been promising to take a friend's son. I decided to open the sunroof. 2 The weather was great. Do you know whether you'll be allowed to go back? 3 It didn't break anything. I had to break quickly. Four. There were red deer and squirrels, things like that. You should have read the rules. Five. I said I was going to write to the manager. That can't be right, can it? Six. We had to wait for ages for it to move. The weight of the animal had left a big dent.
